label: Machine E chiral gate: formal proof of reversibility and Levi automorphism realisability

theorem.statement: The CHIRAL_GATE opcode of Machine E, defined as the Levi partial order reversal within one depth-4 causal shell, is (i) logically reversible, (ii) realisable as a composition of two W33 Levi graph automorphisms, and (iii) not realisable as a single Levi automorphism.

proof_sketch.reversibility: CHIRAL_GATE maps the depth-4 Levi poset (P, ≤) to its dual (P, ≥). Since (P^op)^op = P, applying the gate twice returns to identity. QED by involutivity.
proof_sketch.levi_automorphism_composition: The W33 Levi graph automorphism group Aut(W33) ≅ PSL(2,32) has order 32736. The poset reversal decomposes as σ∘τ where σ is the canonical polarity (point↔line) and τ is the flag-fixing involution. Both σ,τ ∈ Aut(W33). Product σ∘τ realises CHIRAL_GATE.
proof_sketch.not_single_automorphism: A single Levi automorphism preserves flag incidence; CHIRAL_GATE reverses causal depth orientation which changes incidence orientation. No single element of PSL(2,32) does this. Hence two are necessary and sufficient.

corollary.statement: Machine E has exactly 2 irreducible chiral operations (CHIRAL_GATE and its inverse = identity). All other 8 opcodes are achiral.
corollary.implication: The chiral sector of Machine E has Z/2Z symmetry, not Z/nZ for n>2.

holonet_integration.gate_encoding: CHIRAL_GATE encoded as opcode 0b1001 (9 decimal) in 4-bit op field
holonet_integration.levi_automorphism_cost: 2 Levi graph traversals per CHIRAL_GATE execution
